program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((seeds (filter (lambda (cell)
                         (let ((v (third cell)))
                           (or (= v 2) (= v 3) (= v 4) (= v 6) (= v 7) (= v 8))))
                       (grid-cells g))))
    (if (empty? seeds)
        g
        (let* ((seed (first seeds))
               (color (third seed))
               (seen (make-hash)))
          (define queue (list (cons (first seed) (second seed))))
          (hash-set! seen (first queue) #t)
          (let bfs ([step 0])
            (unless (empty? queue)
              (let ((cur (first queue)))
                (set! queue (rest queue))
                (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
                  (let ((nr (+ (car cur) (first d)))
                        (nc (+ (cdr cur) (second d))))
                    (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                               (not (hash-has-key? seen (cons nr nc)))
                               (= (at g nr nc) 0))
                      (hash-set! seen (cons nr nc) #t)
                      (set! queue (append queue (list (cons nr nc))))))))
              (bfs (+ step 1))))
          (for/fold ([out g]) ([key (in-list (hash-keys seen))])
            (if (= (at g (car key) (cdr key)) 0)
                (set-cell out (car key) (cdr key) color)
                out))))))
